content:
I’m pleased to share that I have completed my one-month Legal Internship at The Legal Quorum.
📅 1 July – 31 July 2026
During this journey, I worked on areas including:
• Legal Research
• Case Summarisation
• Article Writing
• Legal Analysis
• Research-based assignments
More than the certificate, I value the skills, discipline, and perspective gained during these four weeks.
A valuable chapter completed — and a stronger foundation for the chapters ahead.
Grateful for the opportunity. 🙏⚖️

comment: Early legal internships often shape research habits that carry into practice. The real value comes from learning how to distinguish relevant facts, reliable authorities, and persuasive reasoning under time constraints.
